questions.prompt: Why can word-for-word notes get in the way of learning?

options.text: They can use attention that could go toward understanding.

questions.explanation: Copying every word can crowd out thinking about meaning.

questions.prompt: What matters when choosing paper or a laptop?

options.text: Using the tool in a way that keeps you engaged with meaning.
Using the same app as everyone else.

questions.explanation: Either can work. The episode encourages processing ideas rather than transcribing.

options.text: Main ideas, definitions, and useful examples.

questions.explanation: Selective notes make the important material easier to find and review.
